concept: Trust-based selling is a system, not a personality trait
canonicalExplanation: Trust-based selling gets misread as a soft skill some reps are naturally better at. It isn't — it's what's left when a sales org removes the incentive to perform for an audience. Give a rep judgment instead of a scorecard, and the honest read on a deal becomes the default output instead of something coached out of them.
avoidWhen: contexts arguing trust means no structure or accountability — it's judgment without an audience, not the absence of process
